Hostinger platform FAQs
What is Hostinger?
Hostinger is an agentic platform that makes building, running, and growing a business feel doable. From websites and online stores to web apps, hosting, domains, and marketing, everything works together in one place. Its AI agents know your business and go beyond giving advice, helping you build, test, launch, and grow your next business idea without figuring out all the tech yourself.
You don’t need to code to build something great. And if you do, you get the tools, control, and infrastructure to build, deploy, and scale on your terms. No juggling a dozen platforms or providers.
Trusted by over 5 million customers in 150+ countries, Hostinger helps even a team of one achieve big things, without the big budgets, endless hours, or extra hires.
Who is Hostinger for?
Hostinger is for anyone who wants to build, run, and grow a successful business online. Whether you're working on your own, with a team, or managing websites for clients.
AI can handle more of the technical tasks or guide you through them, while developers have the flexibility to take full control.
Is Hostinger only a web hosting company?
No. Hostinger has evolved beyond web hosting into an agentic platform for hosting your business online. This includes websites and web apps with AI Builder, domains, Hostinger Ecommerce, Business Email, email marketing, and Hostinger Agent, all in one platform.
Do I need to know how to code to use Hostinger's services?
No, you don't need to know how to code to use Hostinger. With AI Builder, you can describe what you want and AI creates your website, online store, or custom app. You can then shape it using AI chat or drag-and-drop editing.
For more hands-on control, Hostinger also supports WordPress and custom code from the same account.
How do I actually build something on Hostinger?
You can start by describing what you want to AI Builder or choosing a template, then shape your website, web app, or online store with AI chat or drag-and-drop editing.
If you want more control, you can build with WordPress or custom code, including Node.js, PHP, and HTML.
What can I do with Hostinger after I launch?
Once you're live, Hostinger helps you keep running and growing your business from the same agentic platform. You can update your website, add products, manage orders, reach customers with email marketing, improve your content, and automate everyday tasks with AI, all from one account.
How does Hostinger help me get and keep customers?
Hostinger helps people find your business, turn them into customers, and bring them back. You can sell online with Hostinger Ecommerce, create and send AI-powered email campaigns with Hostinger Reach, and use Hostinger Agent to improve your SEO, create content, answer questions, and help with everyday tasks, all from the same account.
Can Hostinger handle more if my business grows?
Yes. You can scale with Hostinger as your business grows. Move to more powerful hosting, VPS, higher-capacity email, or tools for managing multiple client sites, while keeping everything within the same Hostinger account.
How much does the Hostinger platform cost?
Hostinger plans start from $1.99/mo, with different plans depending on what you need. Hosting, domains, business email, AI Builder, and other tools are available across the Hostinger platform, so you can start with what you need and add more as your business grows. See full pricing and what's included in each plan.
Is my business data secure with Hostinger?
Yes. Hostinger takes steps to protect your business data by following global data-protection regulations, mitigating vulnerabilities across its infrastructure, and maintaining systems to help restore services if an emergency affects a location. Security is built into the platform, so you don't have to manage every protection measure alone.
How does Hostinger protect my data when I use AI?
Hostinger protects your data when you use its AI tools. Conversations with Hostinger Agent are not used to train or fine-tune AI models or shared with third parties for advertising or profiling.
Features that share data, such as Web2Agent, require your consent, and you can disable participation at any time. Hostinger is also ISO/IEC 27001:2022 certified and complies with GDPR and other applicable data protection regulations.
How does Hostinger handle copyright when using AI?
Hostinger's AI tools are designed to create original content, not replicate existing work. AI-generated content must comply with applicable copyright laws and intellectual property rights, and the AI image generator is designed not to produce content that violates copyright. You are responsible for ensuring the content you publish complies with copyright law.
Can I manage Hostinger from my own coding tools?
Yes. Hostinger Connector connects your account to tools like Cursor, Claude Code, VS Code, and Windsurf via MCP. You can then manage hosting, domains, DNS, and WordPress directly from your IDE, with one-click OAuth setup and no manual API tokens.
Does Hostinger support automated or agent-driven workflows?
Yes. AI Automation Apps, including OpenClaw, Hermes Agent, and self-hosted n8n, deploy in one click with infrastructure handled for you.
Agentic Mail connects mailboxes to code and AI agents via webhooks, REST API, and MCP, enabling inbox triage bots, automated replies, and other email workflows. See the full agentic AI lineup for more options.

How do I register the free domain included with annual hosting plans?
To activate the free 12-month domain name included with every annual managed hosting for WordPress, cloud hosting, or Website Builder plan, simply log in to your dashboard, click on the Claim domain button, find your perfect domain, and register it.
How do I activate the free SSL certificate?
You don’t need to do anything. We automatically set up your SSL certificate when you sign up, so you can sit back and relax, safe in the knowledge your site is secure.
Can I change my plan, if my circumstances change?
Yes, you can easily upgrade your plan if your circumstances change. Our scalable options allow you to seamlessly switch without any downtime.
Why do different plans cost different amounts?
While all our web hosting plans include everything you need to get your website online, alongside performance and security you can rely on, each plan is tailored to suit different needs. For example, an individual’s professional portfolio website doesn’t require the same ecommerce resources that a medium-sized retailer would need for their online store, or a developer might need to host a dedicated online game server. By offering a variety of plans, we can ensure you only pay for the features and resources you need.
Does Hostinger offer ecommerce hosting?
Yes, we offer a variety of ecommerce plans that include everything you need to open your online store and start selling. All our ecommerce plans include inventory management, multiple payment methods, marketing integrations, client appointment scheduling, and 0% transaction fees, so you keep more of what you make.
Can I migrate existing websites to Hostinger?
Yes, you can quickly and easily migrate your existing website to Hostinger - and it’s free. We offer an unlimited website migrations service that handles everything and ensures you can transfer your site - or sites - without any hassle, cost, data loss, or downtime.
I have a domain name at a different company. Can I transfer it to Hostinger?
Absolutely. You can transfer your domain name to Hostinger by following our simple domain transfer process. Then you can manage your domain and hosting services all in one place.
I'm a professional web developer, which is better for me, web hosting, Cloud hosting, or VPS hosting?
Our Shared hosting is designed to be user-friendly, making it perfect for beginners and small businesses. However, professional-level developers and designers might benefit more from our VPS hosting, which offers more back-end control, flexibility, and resources. Our Cloud hosting plans sit in the middle offering more resources than shared hosting, but less control than VPS hosting.
Can I build a website on WordPress and host it with Hostinger?
Yes. All our hosting plans are compatible with WordPress. Our Managed Hosting for WordPress plan is perfect for making the most out of your WordPress website. Meanwhile, our WooCommerce hosting plan is ideal if you’re opening an online store.

Find answers to the most frequently asked questions about our managed AI automation apps.
What are AI automation apps?
AI automation apps are ready-to-run AI assistants that Hostinger hosts and manages for you. You pick an app from our catalog, connect it to your messaging channel and preferred AI model, and it starts handling tasks like sorting your inbox, drafting replies, running reports, and monitoring topics. There’s no server to set up and nothing to maintain. The catalog grows over time, so you can always launch the app that fits your current needs.
Do I need coding experience to use AI automation apps?
No. Every app is designed for non-technical users. Onboarding is guided step by step, and Hostinger handles all server-level setup automatically. You simply choose your app, connect your preferred messaging channel and AI model, and start using it right away.
Which AI models can I use?
AI automation apps connect to leading AI models, including Claude, GPT, and Gemini, through a single managed integration. That means you get top-tier AI without creating separate accounts or manually configuring API keys for each provider. You choose your model when setting up your app.
What can I do with AI automation apps?
Plenty. Some popular use cases:
Automate customer support on WhatsApp or Telegram
Build a personal assistant for reminders, scheduling, and research
Generate daily or weekly reports based on your criteria
Monitor news, trends, or keywords in your industry
Create custom chatbots for your business or community
Execute multi-step tasks and connect to external tools
The specific capabilities depend on which app you launch. Browse the catalog to see what each one does best.
Can I switch between OpenClaw and Hermes Agent after launching?
Yes, just delete your running application and create a new one: OpenClaw, Hermes Agent or n8n.
Will I lose my data or configurations if I switch apps?
Because each app has its own architecture, your configurations, conversation history, and custom setups don’t transfer automatically when you switch. You’ll start fresh on the new app. We recommend exporting or noting down any important settings before switching.
How much does it cost?
AI automation apps run on one plan. You get your app plus AI credits in a single subscription, with no separate tool fees or per-agent charges. You can switch between apps under the same plan as your needs change, so you’re never locked into one tool.

2. GENERAL PRINCIPLES. CONFIDENTIALITY
Hostinger shall process all Personal Data adhering to the general data processing principles:
lawfully, fairly and in a transparent manner in relation to the data subject ( lawfulness, fairness, and transparency );
collect and process Personal Data only for specified, explicit and legitimate purposes and not further processed in a manner that is incompatible with those purposes ( purpose limitation );
ensure that Personal Data is adequate, relevant and limited to what is necessary for relation to the purposes for which they are processed ( data minimization );
ensure that Personal Data is accurate and, where necessary, kept up to date ( accuracy );
ensure that Personal Data is kept in a form which permits identification of data subjects for no longer than is necessary for the purposes for which the personal data are processed ( storage limitation );
process Personal Data in a manner that ensures appropriate security of the personal data, including protection against unauthorized or unlawful processing and against accidental loss, destruction or damage, using appropriate technical or organizational measures ( integrity and confidentiality ).
All and any information stored on Hostinger's Platform is treated as strictly confidential. All information is stored securely and is accessed by qualified and authorized personnel only.
